items.abstract: <jats:p>As large language models like ChatGPT spread rapidly, some developers are “jailbreaking” the AI by removing default safety restrictions to unlock greater capabilities. However, this precipitates complex dilemmas balancing creative opportunities and risks of misuse. This paper analyzes the multifaceted technical, ethical, and legal implications of uncontrolled ChatGPT jailbreaking. While jailbreaking enables innovative applications from avant-garde art to customized research, lifting constraints also amplifies dangers like privacy breaches, disinformation, and unfair bias amplification at scale. Moreover, jailbreakers face challenges accessing proprietary systems and preserving capabilities during modification. The analysis advocates implementing prudent safeguards and oversight to ensure jailbreaking promotes societal welfare without harm. Independent auditing, cooperation between companies and external developers, and ethical jailbreaking practices are vital to guide the responsible development of increasingly pervasive AI. By balancing wisdom and progress through governance reflecting diverse societal values, ChatGPT’s transformative potential can be harnessed to ethically expand human knowledge and creativity.</jats:p>
title: Pushing Boundaries or Crossing Lines? The Complex Ethics of ChatGPT Jailbreaking
